Two ways to know your property's value
Instantly
With our online valuation tool.

Valuation report
We study your property in depth.
We visit the property and review its documentation.
We analyse the neighbourhood, the market and recent sales.
We deliver the report and discuss it with you.

This is not an official appraisal: it is a market valuation to help you decide with confidence.
Frequently asked questions
What people ask us

items.q: Is it the same as an official appraisal?
items.a: No. An official appraisal is carried out by an accredited valuation firm and is usually required by the bank for a mortgage. Our report is a market valuation: it tells you what a property like yours sells for today.
To decide whether to sell and at what price, but also when dealing with an inheritance, a divorce or a division between co-owners, or simply to know how much your asset is worth.
It's a good first reference. For an important decision, we recommend the full report: it takes into account the actual condition of the property and the building.

items.q: What if I then want to sell?
items.a: The report is the first step of our [sales service](service:venta-estrategica): you will already have the price and the strategy.
